source: Savitsky (1964), Hydrodynamic Design of Planing Hulls, Figure 18, printed page 92 (PDF page 22)
method: Approximate manual readings of the scanned curves, rounded to 0.1 degree. Piecewise linear interpolation in chart coordinate and then deadrise. No extrapolation.
scope: Prismatic planing hull empirical onset boundary; reverse chines and rocker are not resolved. A positive margin is not validation of dynamic stability.
axis: sqrt(C_L / 2), using actual deadrise-surface lift coefficient, not equivalent flat-plate C_L0
